note: Clause 9: CGPA >= 7.50 without backlog may take additional subjects up to 33% of the major requirement; GPA 7.00 must be kept in additional subjects.

Clause 10: a Minor needs six subjects from the school's list, minimum GPA 6.00, at least three as additional credits. The specific CSE subject list is not published in the booklet; the buddy treats any CSE-coded theory subject as a candidate.
Clause 11.6(b): students with backlogs register for offered backlog subjects first; total contact hours may not exceed 28.
Regulations do not state a per-semester cap on additional credits; the buddy uses the student's declared headroom (default 6, at most 12 credits per semester) and the 33% overall limit.
B.Tech CSE elective slots: Elective-1 in semester VI, Elective-2..4 in VII, Elective-5..6 in VIII.

Lateral-1/2/3 slots sit in semesters IV, V and VI of the B.Tech structure; other schools' students take CSE laterals (p.74) in these slots. Slot positions for non-CSE programmes are inferred from the CSE structure.
Regulation 11.6 refers to the 'Third (Autumn) Semester'; odd semesters run in Autumn, even in Spring. A B.Tech has eight semesters.
Clause 15: B.Tech 172-184 credits (admitted from 2009); B.Tech (Hons.) needs CGPA >= 8.5.
One credit = one contact hour per week (L-T-P, booklet tables). The buddy adds an assumed 1 hour of self-study per credit for each additional course.
The 2019 regulations do not mention MOOC/NPTEL credit transfer. Until the academic section confirms a rule, NPTEL and MIT OCW are planned as non-credit learning resources.
